headline: A 2022 law renames the Atlanta VA medical center after Max Cleland, a Georgia veteran and former senator.
what_it_does: This law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs medical center in Atlanta, Georgia, the Joseph Maxwell Cleland Atlanta Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center. It also allows the shorter name, the Joseph Maxwell Cleland Atlanta VA Medical Center. The law changes only the name and does not change how the hospital is run or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 9, 2022.
